verses.1: A song of ascents. Of David. I Had not the LORD been with us, let Israel say,
verses.2: Had not the LORD been with us, when people rose against us,
verses.3: They would have swallowed us alive, for their fury blazed against us.
verses.4: The waters would have engulfed us, the torrent overwhelmed us;
verses.5: seething waters would have drowned us.
verses.6: Blessed be the LORD, who did not leave us to be torn by their fangs.
verses.7: We escaped with our lives like a bird from the fowler's snare; the snare was broken and we escaped.
verses.8: Our help is the name of the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.

notes.text: Our help is the name: for the idiom, see Exodus 18:4.
